events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect walkthrough repo state and the served review index
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-walkthroughs 2>/dev/null && git log --oneline | head -5 && git status --short | head -15; lsof -iTCP:8883 -sTCP:LISTEN -P 2>/dev/null | tail -1; PID=$(lsof -tiTCP:8883 -sTCP:LISTEN | head -1); [ -n "$PID" ] && lsof -a -p $PID -d cwd -Fn | tail -1 && ps -o command= -p $PID; curl -s "http://localhost:8883/wt-review/index.html" | wc -c; curl -s "http://localhost:8883/wt-review/index.html" | grep -o 'href="[^"]*"' | head -40; curl -s "http://localhost:8883/wt-review/index.html" | grep -oiE '<(title|h1|p)[^>]*>[^<]{0,300}' | head -10

events.name: Bash
events.head: Locate the review page directory and its generator
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-walkthroughs; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://localhost:8883/wt-review/index.html; /usr/sbin/lsof -iTCP:8883 -sTCP:LISTEN -P 2>/dev/null | tail -1; find . /tmp /private/tmp -maxdepth 4 -type d -name 'wt-review' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' 2>/dev/null | head; grep -n "wt-review\|8883" scripts/walkthroughs/review.py scripts/walkthroughs/finalize.sh scripts/walkthroughs/WORKFLOW.md 2>/dev/null | head -20; wc -l scripts/walkthroughs/review.py

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the review generator and the current index text
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-walkthroughs; cat scripts/walkthroughs/review.py | cut -c1-700; echo ----; ls app/public/wt-review | tr '\n' ' '; echo; ls -la app/public/wt-review/index.html; sed 's/<[^>]*>/ /g' app/public/wt-review/index.html | tr -s ' \n' | cut -c1-2500; git check-ignore -v app/public/wt-review/index.html; /usr/sbin/lsof -iTCP -sTCP:LISTEN -P 2>/dev/null | grep -E ':88[0-9][0-9]' | head
